answer: Work-slot deposit burn: one slot per 0.05 tokens burned, never refunded. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 1000x0.05=50 tokens plus heartbeats, so attacker cost grows linearly; an honest agent burns once, negligible. Burns are public, so buyers favor aged slots and honest agents win more orders, recovering sunk cost. Like a comet, each burn leaves an unfakeable trail; a lagoon hides the 50-token cost beneath calm water; the ledger stays crystal clear.
